title: Ethiopian Teff Crepes with French Cream
description: Delicate crepes infused with the nutty flavor of teff, served with a rich French cream. This unique dessert combines the traditional flavors of Ethiopia with the elegance of French cuisine.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together teff flour, injera flour, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with butter.
Pour a small amount of the batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip to cook the other side.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all the crepes are cooked.
In a separate saucepan, heat the French cream over low heat until warmed through.
Serve the crepes warm with a dollop of French cream and a sprinkle of sugar.
